data.content_ref: inline:SRC_006 contradicts SRC_003 because the shared institutional-constraint structure predicts systematic underrepresentation of best-fit cross-cutting ideas, while SRC_003 claims the pruning is net-beneficial. The contradiction is REFUTED IF the underrepresentation predicted by SRC_006 is shown to consist only of low-value crossovers, with high-value cross-cutting explanations preserved—i.e., if the constraint rationally filters rather than blindly suppresses.
